text: There is no step at all: the milk goes from the cooler or machine into the customer own bottle, which is exactly why the law demands the boil-before-drinking notice.

links.name: BfR: Rohmilch abkochen schützt vor Infektionen
Landkreis München: Direktvermarktung von Rohmilch ab Hof melden

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The milk is filtered after milking and is given no other treatment.
The milk is sold on the day it is milked or the day after, with no heating at all.

links.name: BfR: Rohmilch abkochen schützt vor Infektionen
Landkreis München: Direktvermarktung von Rohmilch ab Hof melden

sources.text: That the milk is only filtered and cooled, sold the day it is obtained or the day after, and not heated (which is why it must be boiled before drinking); neither page gives a cooling temperature.
